subject: infoschema: simplify isTiFlashStore and isTiFlashWriteNode using slices.ContainsFunc (#64269)
summary: Reviewed diff vs first parent: `pkg/infoschema/tables.go` refactors `isTiFlashStore`/`isTiFlashWriteNode` to `slices.ContainsFunc`, and adds focused unit tests (`pkg/infoschema/tables_test.go`) plus Bazel wiring (`pkg/infoschema/BUILD.bazel`). The refactor preserves behavior for nil/empty `store.Labels` (still returns false) and uses the same `GetKey`/`GetValue` checks, so `GetStoreServerInfo`’s TiFlash classification / engine-role derivation is unchanged. No correctness, consistency, concurrency, or metadata/state-machine risks found; the helpers are unchanged further up to `upstream/master`.
